verdict: Ads are producing sales, but efficiency dipped as spend scaled up.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 35 purchases and $6,648.81 in revenue on $1,500.07 in spend, a 4.43x return. The most recent week saw spend increase roughly 51% over the week prior, and while purchases rose 33%, the return on that higher spend dropped — meaning the new dollars worked less efficiently than the base. Purchase volume is trending slightly upward over the last few days, though average order sizes have softened, which is being watched closely. Ad creative refresh is in motion to improve efficiency as spend stays at its current level.
